name: io.github.diblaze/bokio-mcp
title: bokio-mcp
description: Bokio accounting API as MCP tools: ledger, invoices, SIE balances, VAT, P&L. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: BOKIO_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Private Bearer token, created in Bokio under Integrations

environmentVariables.name: BOKIO_COMPANY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default company, used when a tool call leaves out companyId

environmentVariables.name: BOKIO_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: 1, true, yes or on enables write tools; anything else keeps them hidden and blocked

environmentVariables.name: BOKIO_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where SIE, PDF and upload downloads are saved; paths outside it are rejected and files are never overwritten
